title: Weekly discovery digest — 6 candidates above affinity threshold
narrative: Requests draft here and a person sends them. The Arcadia mould deposit waits behind its RFQ — no non-recoverable money moves before the quote comes back.

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a decaying trend re-opens this card and waits for you.

plan.name: RFQ and sample requests
plan.meta: 3 sample requests · 1 RFQ · drafted, held for review

items.name: C-31 · carbon steel wok — sample request
items.detail: Three units, existing tooling, hammered finish specified with a tolerance note on consistency. Asks them to quote at MOQ 500 in the same reply so the economics land with the sample.

items.name: C-34 · angle guide — sample request
items.detail: Five units at 15° and 20°, with the tolerance requirement written into the request rather than checked afterwards. Fits the existing stone without a shim.

items.name: C-27 · roasting set — RFQ before tooling
items.detail: Quote request first, deposit second. Confirms the $4.2K mould cost and the $26.80 unit price at MOQ 300 before any non-recoverable money moves.

plan.name: Evaluation cards
plan.meta: 3 cards · criteria fixed at creation, not after the sample arrives

items.name: One card per sampled concept
items.detail: Each card opens with its pass criteria already written from Decide, the supplier quote attached, and a named owner. The card closes as pass or fail with the evidence, never as "promising".

items.name: Criteria locked at creation
items.detail: Twelve criteria across the three concepts. Changing one after a sample has arrived requires a logged reason — that is the difference between evaluating and rationalising.

items.name: Photography scheduled per concept
items.detail: Concept shots for evaluation only, booked to land two days after each sample. Not listing photography — that belongs to launch.

plan.name: Parked watchlist
plan.meta: 3 concepts · triggers armed with check cadence

items.name: Triggers armed
items.detail: C-40 checked monthly against two scheduled metro mandates, C-42 quarterly against incumbent delistings, C-38 closed with its decay evidence and no scheduled check.

items.name: Evidence attached to each park
items.detail: Every parked concept keeps the curve, the classifier output and the reason it was parked. When a trigger fires the card re-opens with its original analysis rather than starting again.

items.name: Trend-decay auto-park armed
items.detail: A sampled concept whose durability falls below 55% mid-cycle parks itself with the decay evidence, rather than spending the second sample round on a category that is closing.

plan.name: Launch handoff · lineage
plan.meta: passes flow to the launch flow with full provenance

items.name: Lineage chips travel with the concept
items.detail: The launch decision in S9.8 opens with the signal that found the concept, the affinity read, the supplier quote and the sample results — so nobody has to reconstruct why it is on the list.

items.name: Research pack filed to Ledger
items.detail: Full pack per concept including the parked ones: signals, affinity working, economics model, risk flags and the decision. LEDGER-DISC-0341.

items.name: Cycle summary posted
items.detail: One line back to the innovation goal: what this cycle spent, what it sampled, and what it parked. The 11%-of-revenue gap gets a running record rather than a quarterly surprise.
